title: 1 May 2026 — New Jerusalem, Gate of North, House, Mansions, Ladder & Throne Cluster
purpose: Preserve a dated pre-research cluster showing that Tim explicitly coupled New Jerusalem, Gate of North, House/rooms/mansions, Heaven's Ladder, North Throne, Father/God and Son/grain-of-wheat imagery before the September 2026 Revelation-cube research pass.
source_class: user-originated posts recovered from shared conversation memory; exact post URLs/text should still be attached when source-level recovery is available

importance: This date is a major anti-retrofit anchor. New Jerusalem, Gate, Father's House/mansions, Ladder, Throne, Father/Son and seed/death/return language were already explicitly grouped by Tim months before the September 2026 biblical cube analysis.

biblical_crosswalk.project_phrase: Tower of Babel outside / Heaven's Ladder inside
biblical_crosswalk.relation: humanly constructed upward tower/confusion contrasted with divinely given heaven-earth passage; later Pentecost traditions add communication across plurality
biblical_crosswalk.note: Acts 2 as simple 'reversal of Babel' is debated; it preserves many languages rather than restoring one uniform language.
100,000 remains project magnitude language, not biblical numerology.

new_epiphanies: By 1 May 2026 Tim had already moved from personal Heaven language into communal-city language: 'we are the New Jerusalem.'
House and New Jerusalem are not competing endpoints in the corpus; House can scale outward into City, just as many rooms scale into many inhabitants.
The Babel/Ladder opposition is unusually coherent: Babel tries to build upward to make a name and prevent scattering, while Jacob receives a heaven-earth connection rather than manufacturing it.
The same May cluster contains both Father/House and Son/seed, suggesting architecture and biological regeneration were already being held together before later Garden-City formalization.
North Throne must remain paired with Isaiah 14's warning against self-exaltation; the corpus itself increasingly answers that warning through Gardener/service ethics.
